title: Slice 1A-UI: polished local Next.js founder journey backed by fixture API
body:
## Outcome
A founder can ask a question, edit context and inspect dated evidence in a polished browser journey before live retrieval is available.
## Delivery
Status: Closed (completed), 8 November 2026, on Nissan's instruction. All acceptance met on `main` `0a7d9a6` (table above). The remaining work is in open follow-ups: actual 200% zoom and the screen reader in **#9**, follow-up continuity in **#45**, T13 in **#53**.
Previous status (superseded 8 November 2026): Merged and verified: #39 merged at `d3f54e8` on the owner's instruction; tree identical to the Codex-reviewed head `e75bcef`. Main verified from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/25#issuecomment-6683034761); builder-run, not independent). Real 200% browser zoom deferred to #9 by owner decision. Open only until the #26 facilitator preflight records readiness against `d3f54e8`.
Priority: P0
Iteration: Next / stretch for 01 (#23)
Builder: Claude (claude-fable-5-1), run `claude-25-20261106-1915`, branch `feat/25-fixture-ui`; reviewer: Codex
Dependencies: #24/#33 fixture API and #22/#32 intended fonts are complete; #20 corrections merged. #8 owner design approval granted 6 November 2026 ([decision](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/8#issuecomment-6679674992)); design gate cleared. Coordinate root package/lockfile ownership with #34: land its edits first or explicitly release/reassign the claim before UI package edits; an unreachable-advisory follow-up does not by itself block local-only UI work. #34 remains a gate before hosting/preview deployment or uploads.
## Acceptance
- apps/web calls NestJS through a thin server-side BFF and generated API client. Backend key never reaches browser assets, requests or logs; no Next.js business-rule fork.
- Local-only fixture mode is prominently labelled; contract request/response and error-path tests exercise the actual BFF/API boundary. This does not prove durable authentication, quotas or live slice 1B.
- Implement text question, context editing (including explicit Unknown), up to three next steps, evidence drawer with source/version/date, coverage notice and textual prerequisite sequence. Fixtures distinguish sourced requirements from editorial sequencing; no graph required.
- Responsive mobile/desktop, both themes, keyboard and zoom; verify intended fonts and all relevant focus/error/loading/empty states.
- Recoverable fixture errors preserve draft and distinguish stale output. Fault selection remains local harness configuration, never browser query/header/admin controls.
- Rank and fix biggest visual weaknesses; rerender and inspect. Include before/after evidence, exact build, font checks and limitations per docs/ux/visual-quality.md.
- Facilitator records supported capabilities and readiness for T01, T03, T05, T13, T14 and available T15 variants; no task pass inferred from implementation.

## Review lessons to apply
- Exercise freshness/effective-date boundaries through the real BFF/API, and check the summary, evidence labels, actions and prerequisites agree. A warning must not accompany an affirmative claim that stale evidence is current.
- Verify every citation ID can be used by the evidence drawer; include invalid/expired auth and error-body handling without exposing the server key.
- Test mobile and desktop in both themes, then rank/fix/reinspect visual weaknesses with intended painted fonts. Keep owner taste decisions distinct from rendering defects.
- Coordinate #10 vocabulary within this implementation; avoid a second writer of contracts. Do not close #10's future export criterion on API/UI parity alone.
- Pin build URL/SHA, local fixture reset steps and supported task/variant capabilities for #26. No synthetic actor sees acceptance tests or expected outcomes.

## Exclusions
Comparison/export T04, voice/visual input, hosted deployment and live retrieval are later increments. Do not expose development credentials or configurable test faults in public previews.
## References
docs/06-delivery.md; #10 evidence vocabulary; research/synthetic-ux/runbook.md (facilitator only).

Planning checkpoint: [retrospective and revised plan, PR #35](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/pull/35). Recommendations are not active agent dispatch.


## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

| Acceptance | Status on `main` |
| --- | --- |
| Thin server-side BFF; key never in browser; no business-rule fork | Done (#39); BFF boundary tests 19/19 at `0a7d9a6` |
| Fixture mode labelled; boundary and error tests | Done (#39) |
| Question, context incl. Unknown, next steps, evidence drawer, coverage, textual sequence, sourced vs editorial | Done (#39). #47 added authored stage routes, an answer-context line and plain-language terms |
| Responsive, both themes, keyboard, fonts, states | Done (#39, #47); e2e 52/52 at `0a7d9a6`. **Actual 200% zoom → #9** (deferred by owner decision 6 November) |
| Recoverable errors keep the draft; stale labelled; faults local-only | Done (#39). #47 stopped the stale label showing while a new question loads |
| Visual weaknesses ranked, fixed and re-inspected, with evidence | Done (#39 `apps/web/evidence`; #47 `docs/ux/issue47-review-evidence`) |
| Facilitator records capabilities and readiness for T01/T03/T05/T13/T14/T15 | Done: `preflight/ux26-20261106/manifest.json` and the reconciled record (#48); no task pass inferred |

Nothing remains in this issue. Open work elsewhere: #9 (zoom and screen reader), #45 (continuity), #53 (T13).
